Marshaling a squad of army trainees, the Think It's a Game rapper prepares for a do-or-die mission in "Ammunition," his latest television. Earning the confidence of "Commander Sgt." Metro Boomin, who leant his signature bombast to the track's production, Lucci and his YFN brother YFN Trae Pound explore the deep bonds formed between soldiers when they confront death in battle. The official audio for "Ammunition," published earlier this month, garnered over 216,000 plays on SoundCloud and earned praise from Stereogum, who said "YFN Lucci stands out in the vast Atlanta trap wave right now because he can do bittersweet longing in ways that nobody else can."
